comportamentos: no TypeError/500 when term is missing: present
missing or blank term returns an empty list: missing (the candidate turns nil into "", and name.include?("") is true for every name, so it returns all shadow fields instead of [])
blank term ("") returns an empty list: missing
justificativa: The candidate stops the 500 by turning field into a string, but an empty term then matches every name in the substring loop, so it returns a full list instead of the empty result the official fix gives.
